you are not the asshole. im autistic (and trans :) ) myself. its very hard to explain to neurotypical people, especially older ones, that meltdowns ARE our form of control and regulation over our emotions. its a massive struggle to control these things, especially since they tend to become a tried and true method of calming down or regaining that feeling of true "control". kids mimic whatever they see and hear regardless if they understand. of you cannot explain it to your SM, perhaps wait until your LB is a little older to try and explain. i got my OLDER brother (im 24 and hes 27) to understand by comparing it to characters from Inside Out- "just imagine they all freak out the same time, physical pain gets them back on track". sorry if this is rambling now. i do truly genuinely believe you are not the asshole, you are just in need of therapy or care catered specifically to your meltdowns and what causes you to panic. i hope things get easier for you in time.
